customers_say: Customers find this water purifier offers good value for money, with transparent pricing and the ability to save on service costs. Moreover, the installation process is excellent, and customers appreciate its premium appearance. The purifier performs well, providing pure water and filtering quickly, with one customer noting effective TDS reduction. Additionally, customers are satisfied with the service, and one mentions it stands out among similar products. However, opinions about water taste are mixed, with some finding it excellent while others disagree.

reviews.author: Chandranath Goswami
reviews.title: Very nice to look at first glance
reviews.body: The product is very smart looking and systematic. It's utility will be known after using for long.

reviews.author: Anand stephen
reviews.title: Good purifier with peace of mind
reviews.body: Writing this review after few weeks of usage . Looks classy Does the job and 2 year warranty is peace of mind . And the mobile realtime connectivity is superb . Tested my water tds levels . Before its around 550 .after filteration its around 58 . So better job on filtering . Installation is smooth as well the person knows what he is doing . So peace of mind on that 😊 Recommended one for new buyers .
